info.text:
# Insaniquarium Deluxe

## What does randomization do to this game?

Tank order, pets, and upgrades are randomized into the Archipelago multiworld item pool:

- **Tank Unlocks**: You begin the game with a single unlocked tank and must find unlocks for the remaining tanks in the multiworld.
- **Pets**: The 24 unique pets are shuffled into the item pool.
- **Pet Slots**: How many pet slots you start with and how many pet slots are distributed as items in the multiworld is fully configurable.  
- **Upgrades**: Weapon level upgrades, food quality upgrades, and maximum food capacity upgrades can be found in the multiworld.

## What is a check in this game?

Locations where you receive items include:

- **Egg Purchases**: In each level purchasing egg pieces awards an Archipelago check. You can configure whether checks are awarded for only the final egg piece (20 checks), two pieces (40 checks), or all 3 egg pieces per level (60 checks).
- **Tank Clears**: Defeating each tank's final boss or completing its last level awards a completion check (`Tank 1 Complete` through `Tank 4 Complete`).
- **Bonus Pets**: Purchasing the 4 bonus pets (`Bonus Pet 1` through `Bonus Pet 4`) can optionally be included as non-filler locations.
- **Time Trials**: Optionally include 4 completion checks for beating each tank's Time Trial mode.
- **Challenge Mode**: Optionally include 4 completion checks for beating each tank's Challenge Mode.
- **Aliensanity**: Defeating each unique alien boss/type for the first time awards an item check.
- **Alien Randomization**: Optionally randomizes which tanks each alien appears in.

## What is the goal of Insaniquarium Deluxe when randomized?

The base requirement is always to complete all 4 Adventure Tanks. Additional goals can be optionally added:

- **Cyrax Required**: Choose whether you must defeat the final boss Cyrax.
- **Time Trial Required**: Require completing all 4 Time Trials to win.
- **Challenge Mode Required**: Require completing all 4 Challenge Mode tanks to win.

## What traps can be sent to Insaniquarium Deluxe?

If trap chance is enabled in your options, filler items may be replaced with:

- **Alien Attack Trap**: Immediately spawns an alien attack in your current tank.
- **Famine Trap**: Instantly drops all fish in your tank into starvation.

## Death Link

- **Death Link** (`death_link`): Enable or disable Death Link.
- **Death Link Fish Threshold** (`death_link_amnesty`): Configure how many fish must die in your tank before triggering an outgoing Death Link to the multiworld (default: 5).
- **Death Link Receive Effect** (`death_link_effect`): Choose how your tank responds when receiving an incoming Death Link:
  - **Kill All Fish**: Instantly wipes all fish currently in your tank.
  - **Activate Trap**: Triggers a random active trap (Alien Attack or Famine Trap).

tutorials.title: Multiworld Setup Guide
tutorials.description: A guide to playing Insaniquarium Deluxe with Archipelago.
tutorials.text:
## Required Software

- **Insaniquarium Deluxe** (Disk or Steam version)
- **Archipelago**: Version `0.6.7` or newer
- **Insaniquarium Client**: Download from [Github repository](https://github.com/benyoung32/WinFish) or provided `winfish-source` folder. This is a modified version of the WinFish decompilation project. It only includes the code, assets from your copy of the game are needed to run it

## Installation

1. Download the provided `insaniquarium.apworld` from the file below and install into the Archipelago Launcher
2. Download the modified client from the files below or from the [Github repository](https://github.com/benyoung32/WinFish)
3. Copy the data asset folders (data, properties, fishsongs...) and `bass.dll` from your copy of Insaniquarium Deluxe into the clients's root directory

## Generating

1. Download `Insaniquarium Deluxe.yaml`
2. Edit your desired options, save, and move the yaml file in your Players folder
3. Generate APWorld using the Archipelago Launcher

## Playing

1. Launch **Insaniquarium Deluxe.exe** from inside the `winfish-source` zip after copying in the necessary asset folders
2. From the main menu, go to the profile selection screen
3. Click the `NEW CONNECTION` button
4. Enter your Archipelago connection information:
   - **Server / Host**: Host address and port (e.g., `archipelago.gg:38281` or `localhost:38281`)
   - **Slot Name**: The player name specified in your configuration YAML (`name: Player1`).
   - **Password**: Password for the room (leave blank if none)

﻿Archipelago world integration for **Insaniquarium Deluxe**
## Required Software

- **Insaniquarium Deluxe** (Disk or Steam version)
- **Archipelago**: Version `0.6.7` or newer
- **Insaniquarium Client**: Download from [Github repository](https://github.com/benyoung32/WinFish) or provided `winfish-source` folder. This is a modified version of the WinFish decompilation project. It only includes the code, assets from your copy of the game are needed to run it

## Installation

1. Download the provided `insaniquarium.apworld` from the file below and install into the Archipelago Launcher
2. Download the modified client from the files below or from the [Github repository](https://github.com/benyoung32/WinFish)
3. Copy the data asset folders (data, properties, fishsongs...) and `bass.dll` from your copy of Insaniquarium Deluxe into the clients's root directory

## Generating

1. Download `Insaniquarium Deluxe.yaml`
2. Edit your desired options, save, and move the yaml file in your Players folder
3. Generate APWorld using the Archipelago Launcher

## Playing

1. Launch **Insaniquarium Deluxe.exe** from inside the `winfish-source` zip after copying in the necessary asset folders
2. From the main menu, go to the profile selection screen
3. Click the `NEW CONNECTION` button
4. Enter your Archipelago connection information:
   - **Server / Host**: Host address and port (e.g., `archipelago.gg:38281` or `localhost:38281`)
   - **Slot Name**: The player name specified in your configuration YAML (`name: Player1`).
   - **Password**: Password for the room (leave blank if none)
---

---

## What's New in v0.3.0

### Client Updates

- **Archibald sprite** - The archibald sprite created by discord @bootsowen is now displayed in game, and the hatching screen has been reworked to reflect progress in the Archipelago
- **Simplified Connection Process** - Removed the need to create and import a patch file per save. All option information is now handled by the connection handshake between client and server
- **Bigger windowed mode** - Added a 2x scale option to the pause menu to make the game more playable in windowed mode! Still research to be done for borderless windowed mode  
- **Autofire Setting** - Wrist getting tired? New check box added to the pause menu to enable the rapid fire weapon mode which is typically locked to the max weapon upgrade
- **Info Page** - New GUI page added to the client to track remaining checks, received items, and goal progress

### Changes

- **Priority Locations** - Tank completions are now marked as priority to make progression items more likely to show up in exciting places. Aliens are also priority if aliensanity is enabled.
- **Bonus Shell Tickets** - The `bonus shell filler` item no longer just gives shells, it now gives a ticket to start a random tank's bonus round from the tank select. Gotta earn those shells!
- **Bonus Pet Locations** (`bonus_pet_locations`) - Bonus pets are now always included as locations. This option now chooses how many bonus pet locations are allowed as default locations (can hold progression) vs filler only (0-4).

### New YAML Options

- **Death Link** (`death_link`) - Toggle Death Link integration. Now your friends can share in the insanity!
- **Death Link Fish Amnesty** (`death_link_amnesty`) - Configures how many fish must die before sending a Death Link
- **Death Link Receive Effect** (`death_link_effect`) - Configures the penalty when receiving a Death Link (kill all fish or activate trap)
- **Alien Randomization** (`alien_randomization`) - Randomizes which tanks each alien appears in. Each tank has 3-4 aliens, and each alien appears in at least 2 tanks. Each level deeper in a tank has more chance to spawn two at once. Good luck with the 1-1 bilaterus ;)
- **Bonus Starting Guppies** (`bonus_starting_guppies`) - Sets the maximum number of bonus starting guppies included in the filler pool (0-10). Each filler item has a 50% chance of being a bonus starting guppy until this limit is reached

### Planned Features

- **Tracker integration** - Integrate APWorld with pop tracker
---

## Release Assets
- **`insaniquarium.apworld`**: Archipelago game world package.
- **`Insaniquarium.yaml`**: Player configuration YAML template.
- **`winfish-source-v0.3.0.zip`**: Source code of the WinFish Archipelago client.
